tasks.title: Implement Self-Updating Skills/Hooks/Optimization Catalog
tasks.description: Create a single readable .grok/SKILLS_HOOKS_OPTIMIZATION.md file that is auto-generated. It contains clearly marked sections for Skills Catalog, Hooks, and Optimization Heuristics. The catalog is kept up-to-date by the skill-builder meta-skill and a new `grok skills generate-catalog` command. The file is injected into context so the model always has accurate knowledge of available skills, hooks, and perf patterns.
tasks.details:
- Add generate_context_catalog() in src/skills/ that produces nicely formatted Markdown with clear <!-- SECTION --> markers.
- Sections:
  1. SKILLS CATALOG (name, desc, triggers, arbitration, when to prefer)
  2. HOOKS (before/after tool hooks, how to rely on them)
  3. OPTIMIZATION HEURISTICS (from perf work + rules)
- Add `GenerateCatalog` to SkillsCommand.
- Call the generator after successful skill creation (New, and from skill-builder).
- Wire the catalog file into global context loading.
- Seed the initial catalog.
- Update skill-builder/SKILL.md to mention regenerating the catalog.
tasks.testStrategy:
- `grok skills generate-catalog` produces the file with all three sections.
- After creating a new skill, catalog updates automatically.
- File contains clear readable markers for each part.
- Catalog appears in interactive context / system prompt.
- cargo test still passes.
